testimonials.text: There were color coded blue and white strings to decrease confusion which helped massively in understanding the basic throws and knots.
The videos in which he explains very well how to tie the knots with both hands.

I found the step-by-step videos for one-handed and two-handed knot-tying most interesting. The clear demonstrations and the self-assessment challenges helped me build confidence in a practical skill I can use in surgery.
The fact that the course was offered for people who are right handed and left handed was interesting and insightful.
Crisp and accurate. The type of content that is to be advocated by attendings and consultants.
Correcting my longstanding mistake of not crossing hands while doing one handed knot.
